They're spinning it as if mere suspicion of passing sensitive information to someone in Pakistan wasn't solid grounds to hold him, and it was supposedly nothing more than telephonic contact with that Karachi-based “Punjabi Kuri.” But this reeks of the elites and institutions coordinating in the shadows to bury real threats and keep their back channels safe from exposure. They're clearly twisting the courts to paint it as overreach, all to shield the hidden interests that actually run these operations without any real scrutiny.
